summary.value: The Well caps at your Crisis score, empties at every rest, and pays any Skill that spends HP.

system.description: The Well caps at your Crisis score, empties at every rest, and pays any Skill that spends HP. Fill it by being overhealed (spend MP equal to half the excess) — or by feeding: an interlude, never a conflict action; a willing donor spends the HP and marks their Bond toward you, a stranger fills it free and ticks that district's Miasma Clock. Spend it: once per turn, soak damage on you or another before it lands; add half-spent-HP extra damage on a successful attack or offensive spell; or an action heals you or an ally for half the HP spent.
